requirements.description: User prefers an energy class C or better, so the energy class must be A1, A2, A3, A4, B or C. Area, capacity and public transport requirements are not energy-related and are excluded.

User wants the property near public transport (metro, bus, stations). Proximity expressed as 'near', so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.
The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The 14-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 180, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). The tipologia_bene_immobile requirement was omitted because that column is not in the filterable_columns allowlist. Results are ordered by distance to the coordinates.
